Synopsis:
Default Dialogue - the conversation you can have with Minthara at any thime when she's a member of your party. You can ask her about herself, or events that you've experienced together during your adventures. Her responses to you may differ based on some of the choices you make after she joins. Provided you don't betray her for another, she will continue to stand by you, revelling in the violence that follows.

Cluster Contexts:
- Minthara_InParty_Nested_Backstory.json: Minthara is a drow Nightwarden who can travel as a companion and be questioned about her past and the party’s shared experiences; if you keep her loyalty she remains violent and loyal to your cause. The provided lines recount her failed strike at Moonrise Towers: she led a retinue from House Baenre, was seduced by General Ketheric Thorm’s flattery, and was betrayed when Orin the Red slaughtered her men. She was taken captive, forced to watch her soldiers being processed, and had a tadpole implanted in her eye—events she recalls with anger, shame, and a desire for revenge. Nearby, the party may have recently disturbed a windmill (flinging a gnome and drawing off goblin scouts) and might be carrying the Moonlantern pixie; those off‑screen incidents can shape who’s present and how conversations proceed.
- Minthara_InParty.json: Minthara is a drow Nightwarden and paladin who once swore a bloody oath to Lolth but now admits she has “sinned” against the Spider Queen. In party talk she alternates between claiming her oath still guides her (vowing vengeance on the Absolute’s servants) and saying the oath is broken and that she feels liberated — different lines reflect different player choices. She openly intends to seize the Absolute’s power to remake the world and insists she’ll control it, promising to eradicate anyone who opposes her rule. These exchanges occur while she is a companion whose continued loyalty depends on the player not betraying her, and the player’s remarks often call out her ambition as hypocritical or self‑serving.
- Minthara_InParty_Nested_PartyMemberThoughts.json: Default Dialogue - the conversation you can have with Minthara at any thime when she's a member of your party. You can ask her about herself, or events that you've experienced together during your adventures. Her responses to you may differ based on some of the choices you make after she joins. Provided you don't betray her for another, she will continue to stand by you, revelling in the violence that follows.
- Minthara_InParty_Nested_IPRDs.json: Default Dialogue - the conversation you can have with Minthara at any thime when she's a member of your party. You can ask her about herself, or events that you've experienced together during your adventures. Her responses to you may differ based on some of the choices you make after she joins. Provided you don't betray her for another, she will continue to stand by you, revelling in the violence that follows.
- CAMP_Minthara.json: Minthara, now freed from the influence of the Absolute and from a jail cell at Moonrise Towers, joins the players' party at their Camp. She is shaken from her experiences, and is coming to terms with the fact that she now understands the truth about the Absolute - that it is not a god at all, but something monstrous that lies within Moonrise.She wishes to join with the party, knowing they can help her get vengeance against the cult, and knowing that they are her only hope of salvation, thanks to the Prism that they hold, which shuts out the Absolute's voice.

retrieved_synopses: Minthara is a drow Nightwarden who can travel as a companion and be questioned about her past and the party’s shared experiences; if you keep her loyalty she remains violent and loyal to your cause. The provided lines recount her failed strike at Moonrise Towers: she led a retinue from House Baenre, was seduced by General Ketheric Thorm’s flattery, and was betrayed when Orin the Red slaughtered her men. She was taken captive, forced to watch her soldiers being processed, and had a tadpole implanted in her eye—events she recalls with anger, shame, and a desire for revenge. Nearby, the party may have recently disturbed a windmill (flinging a gnome and drawing off goblin scouts) and might be carrying the Moonlantern pixie; those off‑screen incidents can shape who’s present and how conversations proceed.

Minthara is a drow Nightwarden and paladin who once swore a bloody oath to Lolth but now admits she has “sinned” against the Spider Queen. In party talk she alternates between claiming her oath still guides her (vowing vengeance on the Absolute’s servants) and saying the oath is broken and that she feels liberated — different lines reflect different player choices. She openly intends to seize the Absolute’s power to remake the world and insists she’ll control it, promising to eradicate anyone who opposes her rule. These exchanges occur while she is a companion whose continued loyalty depends on the player not betraying her, and the player’s remarks often call out her ambition as hypocritical or self‑serving.

Default Dialogue - the conversation you can have with Minthara at any thime when she's a member of your party. You can ask her about herself, or events that you've experienced together during your adventures. Her responses to you may differ based on some of the choices you make after she joins. Provided you don't betray her for another, she will continue to stand by you, revelling in the violence that follows.

Minthara, now freed from the influence of the Absolute and from a jail cell at Moonrise Towers, joins the players' party at their Camp. She is shaken from her experiences, and is coming to terms with the fact that she now understands the truth about the Absolute - that it is not a god at all, but something monstrous that lies within Moonrise.She wishes to join with the party, knowing they can help her get vengeance against the cult, and knowing that they are her only hope of salvation, thanks to the Prism that they hold, which shuts out the Absolute's voice.
context: Minthara is a drow Nightwarden and former paladin who now travels as a companion after being freed from Moonrise Towers; she led a Baenre strike that was betrayed, was taken captive and had a tadpole implanted, and those events fuel her anger and appetite for vengeance. In camp and on the road you can question her about her oath and shared adventures; her replies vary with your choices — sometimes she insists her bloody oath endures, other times she says the oath is broken and she feels liberated. She repeatedly declares she will seize and harness the Absolute’s power to remake the world and eradicate any who oppose her, and she will remain loyal only so long as you do not betray her to another.
